security_audit.summary: Most static backtick and path traversal alerts are Markdown formatting or placeholder URLs rather than executable code. Confirmed risks are the intended use of the RunComfy CLI, third-party network processing, and a source mismatch that points users to another repository. No prompt injection attempt was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Update SKILL.md links and install command to the audited doany-ai source, or document why the agentspace-so repository is authoritative.
Make command execution explicit, pin the RunComfy CLI version when possible, and require user confirmation before running commands.
Warn users that prompts and image URLs are sent to RunComfy, and avoid sensitive or private assets without approval.
Document token storage clearly and recommend RUNCOMFY_TOKEN for ephemeral CI environments.

content.user_title: Edit Images with GPT Image 2 on RunComfy
content.value_statement: Targeted image edits often drift, especially with faces, brands, and text. This skill provides RunComfy CLI patterns for GPT Image 2 edits with preservation-focused prompts.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to invoke openai/gpt-image-2/edit with the RunComfy CLI.
Explains required prompt and images fields, plus supported size values.
Provides preservation prompt patterns for faces, brands, framing, and layout.
Gives multilingual in-image text instructions with quoted target text.
Supports multi-reference prompts using up to ten public HTTPS image URLs.
Documents relevant exit codes, token storage, and outbound RunComfy endpoints.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, and authentication.
Input images must be public HTTPS URLs that RunComfy can fetch.
It is not designed for batch editing large SKU catalogs.
Prompts, image URLs, and outputs are processed by RunComfy services.

use_cases.title: Localize Ad Creative
use_cases.description: Replace image headlines in another language while preserving layout, product placement, and brand marks.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Variants
use_cases.description: Change backgrounds or text for a product image while keeping the main product stable.

use_cases.title: Compose Reference Images
use_cases.description: Combine a subject from one image with a scene or palette from other references.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Background Swap
prompt_templates.scenario: Use one product or portrait image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Keep the main subject, pose, clothing, and brand marks unchanged. Replace only the background with a clean studio setting.

prompt_templates.title: Localized Headline Edit
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when only image text should change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Keep the photo, layout, lighting, and logo unchanged. Replace only the headline with "Your translated text" in the same position.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-Reference Composition
prompt_templates.scenario: Use a primary subject plus one or more style references.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the subject from image 1 and the room style from image 2. Match lighting and preserve subject identity.

prompt_templates.title: Precise Layout Revision
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when placement and typography matter.
prompt_templates.prompt: Keep the product and brand assets unchanged. Move the headline to the bottom center, update the CTA text, and preserve spacing.

output_examples.input: A portrait needs a neutral studio background without changing the person.
output_examples.output: A command-ready edit prompt that prioritizes face, pose, clothing, and background replacement.

output_examples.input: A poster headline must be rewritten in Japanese while preserving the original layout.
output_examples.output: A prompt that quotes the Japanese text and limits the edit to the headline area.

output_examples.input: A product should be placed into a room from a second reference image.
output_examples.output: A multi-reference prompt that identifies image 1 as the subject and image 2 as the scene.

best_practices: State preservation requirements before the requested change.
Quote exact in-image text and name the script or language.
Use size auto unless the edit requires a new aspect ratio.
anti_patterns: Combining many unrelated edits into one long prompt.
Using vague instructions such as make it better or improve the image.
Passing private images through public URLs without approval.

faq.question: Does this skill generate images from scratch?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on editing existing images through the GPT Image 2 edit endpoint.

faq.question: What tools does it support?
faq.answer: It is marked compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Do I need a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow requires the RunComfy CLI and authentication before model calls work.

faq.question: Can it edit text inside an image?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions emphasize quoting exact replacement text and preserving the surrounding layout.

faq.question: How many reference images can I use?
faq.answer: The skill documents up to ten public HTTPS image URLs for one edit request.

faq.question: Where are images processed?
faq.answer: Prompts and image URLs are sent to RunComfy model API endpoints for processing.
